prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，比较职称、出诊时段和擅长领域。","reading":"先定位合并的科室，再逐行查看医生及其出诊时间，并根据擅长领域选择；同一科室的合并单元格可利用多位医生的行高容纳换行。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同标识医生及其专业背景。","出诊时间和擅长领域分别支持就诊安排与医生选择，需要逐行对应。"],"keep_intact":["医生姓名","单个出诊时段，如“周一上午”","职称尽可能按完整词组显示"],"may_wrap":["科室名称可在汉字之间换行，合并单元格的高度可吸收换行。","多个出诊时段可在标点处换行。","擅长领域是长篇中文描述，可自然换行。","较长职称在空间不足时可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [53, 67, 53, 83, 103] · table 360×2174px · row heights [36, 339, 315, 292, 292, 292, 292, 315] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [53, 67, 53, 88, 98] · table 360×2174px · row heights [36, 339, 315, 292, 292, 292, 292, 315] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 14 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [53, 67, 69, 83, 87] · table 360×2709px · row heights [36, 432, 385, 362, 385, 362, 362, 385] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 18 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"科室分组清楚，医生姓名完整，表头均保持单行。擅长领域获得了三种方案中最多的空间，描述的行长和整体高度相对较好。","problems":"职称被拆成两三行；出诊时段如“周一上午”被拆开，扫读排班不够顺畅。擅长领域仍很窄，长描述使每位医生的行高很大，其他列留下大量空白。","cause":"职称列53px仅容纳约两个汉字，时间列83px不足以完整容纳四字时段；擅长领域列103px在固定总宽下仍只能显示较短的中文行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"姓名完整、表头单行，科室与医生的对应关系清楚；与r1A相比，时间列略宽。","problems":"实际渲染中时间仍在时段内部断行，职称也仍被拆开；擅长领域略窄，但表格高度没有改善，因此增加时间列宽度尚未带来明显收益。","cause":"时间列88px未达到当前文本和换行规则所需的有效宽度；擅长领域从103px减至98px，仍处于相近的换行区间。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"姓名完整，科室分组与表头仍易于辨认；较宽的职称列让每行能显示更多职称文字。","problems":"职称依然没有完整显示，时间仍在时段内部断开；擅长领域变成很窄的文字条，描述碎片化，行高显著增加，跨列对应也更费力。","cause":"职称列增至69px仍不足以容纳最长职称，却使擅长领域列降至87px；时间列仍为83px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"time-threshold","widths":[53,67,53,92,94],"change":"在r1B基础上继续增加时间列，测试能否完整显示四字时段；保留姓名和表头宽度，并观察擅长领域缩窄后的高度代价。"},{"name":"specialty-first","widths":[53,67,53,80,106],"change":"略收窄时间列，把空间交给擅长领域，测试是否跨过更长行的换行阈值；接受时间更可能断行，以比较长描述的可读性和行高收益。"},{"name":"full-times","widths":[53,67,53,99,87],"change":"给时间列更充裕的宽度，尝试让完整时段及相邻标点一起显示；用与r1C相同的擅长领域宽度检验排班可读性是否值得额外行高。"}]}
